title: German Chancellor: Russia Not Yet Ready for Peace Negotiations
detail: German Chancellor stated that Russia is not yet ready for peace negotiations with Ukraine, contradicting earlier signals from Moscow and dimming prospects for near-term diplomacy. The assessment reinforces Western skepticism about Russian diplomatic overtures and signals continued German support for Ukraine's negotiating position.

title: NATO Member State Reports Suspected Russian Attack on Its Territory
detail: A NATO member state announced a suspected Russian attack on its territory, escalating concerns about Russian hybrid warfare operations expanding beyond Ukraine's borders. The incident raises significant alarm among Alliance members about Russia's willingness to directly target NATO states.
